scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @shootball/game-server && npm run build --workspace @shootball/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @shootball/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @shootball/game-server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @shootball/web && npm run test --workspace @shootball/game-server
